sub_area: DB sequence generator (create_sequence, get_next_sequence_val, set_next_sequence_val)
rationale: Tests Frappe's DB sequence API (tabSeries-backed autoname helper), invoked entirely in-process via frappe.db; ferro uses its own naming.rs for naming_series and does not expose or replicate the sequence generator API.

sub_area: Website sitemap.xml generation
rationale: Tests the Frappe website renderer's sitemap.xml output via get_html_for_route in-process; ferro does not implement the website/portal renderer subsystem at all.

sub_area: SQLiteSearch base class implementation (test helper subclass only)
rationale: This is a test-only subclass of SQLiteSearch used as a fixture; it contains no test methods itself and exercises no HTTP path or ferro-relevant behavior.

sub_area: Full-text SQLite search index lifecycle, search, permissions, background indexing
rationale: Tests Frappe's SQLiteSearch full-text search subsystem (index build, querying, scoring, deduplication) entirely in-process; ferro does not implement a full-text search index and this is a Python-only subsystem.

sub_area: Test harness utilities (document assertions, thread-locals cleanup, setting changes, time freezing, missing-doctype generators)
rationale: Tests internal Frappe test-framework helpers (IntegrationTestCase utilities, generators) with no HTTP involvement; these are purely dev-tooling and have no bearing on ferro's correctness.

sub_area: TracedDocument/traced_field descriptor validation in test mode
rationale: Tests Python-only descriptor machinery (TracedDocument, traced_field) for field-value validation during tests; this is a Frappe Python-internal feature with no HTTP surface and no ferro relevance.

sub_area: TracedField context manager with forbidden values and custom validation
rationale: Tests the UnitTestCase.trace_fields() context manager for field-level validation assertions; entirely in-process Python test tooling with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Translation/i18n: cache, extraction, language variants, lazy translations, request language resolution
rationale: Tests Frappe's Python-side translation subsystem (cache, file extraction, language resolution from cookies/headers, JS extractor); ferro does not implement i18n and serves raw field values from SQLite without translation.

sub_area: Two-factor authentication (TOTP, OTP token confirm, 2FA policy, IP restriction)
rationale: Tests Frappe's two-factor auth subsystem (pyotp, session-based OTP cache, 2FA flags) entirely in-process via frappe.twofactor; ferro's auth.rs supports only token/Basic auth and deliberately excludes 2FA.

sub_area: Filter expression evaluation (safe_filters parsing, dict/list/operator forms)
rationale: Tests Frappe's filter parsing logic used by get_list; ferro's orm.rs must handle the same filter operators (=, !=, >, <, in, not in, is, between, timespan) — the behavior is partially encoded here even though tests run in-process.

sub_area: money_in_words() formatting utility
rationale: Tests pure Python number-to-words formatting utility; no HTTP surface and no ferro relevance.

sub_area: scrub_urls() relative URL expansion in HTML
rationale: Tests HTML URL rewriting utility; pure Python helper with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Type-cast utilities (cstr, cint, cfloat, cdate, cdatetime, ctime)
rationale: Tests Python utility casting functions; these are internal helpers not exposed over HTTP and not reimplemented in ferro.

sub_area: floor/ceil math utilities
rationale: Tests pure Python math helper functions; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: HTML sanitization utilities (clean_email_html, sanitize_html)
rationale: Tests HTML sanitization Python utilities; no HTTP surface and no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Validation utilities (URL, email, phone, name, IBAN)
rationale: Tests Python validation helper functions; not exposed over HTTP by ferro.

sub_area: Image EXIF stripping and optimization utilities
rationale: Tests image processing Python utilities; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Python expression validator for field conditions
rationale: Tests validate_python_code() which validates JS-vs-Python expression syntax; purely internal Python utility, no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Document version diff utilities (version_query, get_version_diff)
rationale: Tests version/diff utilities that depend on the Version doctype and Python-side diff logic; ferro does not implement versioning.

sub_area: Date/time utility functions (get_first_day_of_week, get_timedelta, format_duration, etc.)
rationale: Tests a wide range of Python date/time helper functions; these are internal utilities not surfaced by ferro.

sub_area: JSON response handler serialization (json_handler for dates, Decimal, Document, sets)
rationale: Tests Frappe's JSON serialization handler for custom types; ferro has its own JSON serialization in Rust and does not use this Python handler.

sub_area: Timedelta formatting/parsing utilities
rationale: Tests Python timedelta string formatting/parsing utilities; not relevant to ferro.

sub_area: XLSX HTML unescaping utility
rationale: Tests Excel/XLSX HTML handling utility; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: Link title doctypes in boot_info and getdoc response
rationale: Tests that doctypes with show_title_field_in_link are included in boot_info and that link title fields appear in getdoc; ferro's desk.rs handles getdoc but may not fully implement link_title_map boot metadata.

sub_area: parse_app_name() for git/github URLs
rationale: Tests bench CLI app-name parsing utility; dev tooling with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: get_newargs() function introspection utility
rationale: Tests Python function argument introspection helper; purely internal utility with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: make_random utilities (get_random, can_make, how_many)
rationale: Tests demo data generation utilities; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: lazy_import() deferred module loading
rationale: Tests Python lazy import mechanism; purely internal Python tooling.

sub_area: Gravatar/identicon generation
rationale: Tests avatar/identicon image generation utilities; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: dict_to_str and remove_blanks utilities
rationale: Tests trivial dict utility functions; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: File-based distributed locking (filelock, global locks)
rationale: Tests Frappe's file-lock synchronization utility; ferro handles concurrency via Rust's Tokio and does not use Python file locks.

sub_area: Miscellaneous utilities (get_file_timestamp, execute_in_shell, get_sites, get_site_info, get_url_to_form, safe_json_loads, expand_relative_urls)
rationale: Tests a mix of bench/site utility helpers; none of these are reimplemented by ferro or relevant to its REST surface.

sub_area: Type validation for whitelisted API functions (@validate_argument_types, force_types)
rationale: Tests Frappe's Python-side argument type validation decorator for whitelisted methods; ferro does not implement Python-level type enforcement.

sub_area: Traceback sanitization (password masking in tracebacks)
rationale: Tests Python traceback sanitization to redact password values; purely Python internal tooling.

sub_area: flt() rounding (Commercial vs Banker's rounding methods)
rationale: Tests Frappe's floating-point rounding utilities; pure Python arithmetic helpers with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: validate_argument_types decorator with AsyncMock/MagicMock DocType
rationale: Tests type validation decorator applied to DocType methods in-process; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: parse_github_url utility for changelog links
rationale: Tests GitHub URL parsing utility for changelog display; no ferro relevance.

sub_area: sha256_hash utility function
rationale: Tests a single SHA-256 hash helper; ferro has its own crypto.rs with SHA-256 but this tests the Python utility, not ferro's implementation.

sub_area: UTM tracker URL building and parsing utilities
rationale: Tests UTM tracking URL utilities (add_trackers_to_url, parse_and_map_trackers_from_url, map_trackers); website marketing tooling with no ferro relevance.

sub_area: comma_and/comma_or list formatting with i18n
rationale: Tests string joining utilities with locale-aware connectors; pure Python internal utility.

sub_area: msgprint XSS sanitization in message log
rationale: Tests frappe.msgprint() script-tag stripping behavior; an in-process Python UI helper not relevant to ferro's REST responses.

sub_area: Virtual DocType CRUD (insert, update, get_list, get_count, delete via custom controller using JSON file backend)
rationale: Tests Frappe's virtual DocType feature where a custom Python controller handles storage (JSON file); ferro only reads/writes real SQLite-backed tab* tables and does not support virtual doctype controllers.

sub_area: Web Form publish/unpublish and HTTP response code via website renderer
rationale: Tests the Frappe website renderer serving Web Form pages (published=200, unpublished=404) using frappe.website.serve.get_response; ferro does not implement the website/portal/webform renderer.

sub_area: Website page renderer: home page, static pages, error pages, login, redirects, caching, metatags, breadcrumbs, hooks
rationale: Tests Frappe's website/portal renderer (get_response, StaticPage, home_page resolution, custom renderers) entirely in-process; ferro serves SPAs and Desk but does not implement the Frappe website renderer.
